title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: settling the premium balance on a cover
content:
## Situation of use

This entry belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It applies when a cover holder settles the premium of a bound cover in full, in person; the amount paid is the premium balance owed on the cover.

## Scope boundary

This entry governs every premium settled after binding. A premium that the cover eligibility rules require to be received before binding, because the holder's credit status is cash in advance and the product requires prepayment, is outside this entry.

## Rules for the payment

1. A remittance is taken only against premium already charged to the cover, so a bound cover whose premium has not yet been charged has it charged before the holder pays.
2. The balance is worked out on a bound cover, so, outside the prepaid case, a quoted cover is bound before its premium is settled.
3. The payment reference is written exactly as the cover holder quotes it, and a reference is recorded once per cover.

## Entry conditions

- Premium has been charged to the cover, so the unpaid premium on the cover carries the amount the holder's payment settles.
- The quoted cover has been bound, so it carries a binding date and the insured value fixed at binding.

## What the tool does

The cover holder uses pay_cover_premium_9f1f968f to settle premium on its own cover during the call. One call books one premium payment entry on the cover's premium and settlement account, dated today, carrying the holder's reference, and lowers the cover's unpaid premium balance by the amount paid. On success the holder receives the payment entry reference and the premium still due afterwards.

## How it is invoked

pay_cover_premium_9f1f968f is a customer-side tool: it must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves. The desk gives the cover holder the cover reference from the cover lookup.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| cover_id | Cover reference number of the cover whose premium is paid | Identifier given to the cover holder by the desk from the cover lookup |
| amount_usd | Amount of premium paid | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |
| payment_reference | The cover holder's own remittance reference for this payment, exactly as the holder states it | Verbatim: copied character for character, keeping letters, digits, hyphens and case, with no translation, normalisation, summarising, adding or dropping of characters |

## Return

On success the tool returns: status ("paid" when the payment entry was booked); payment_event_id (reference of the new premium payment entry); cover_id; amount_usd (USD with 2 decimal places, as booked); payment_reference (the reference recorded); premium_due_usd (the cover's unpaid premium after the payment, USD with 2 decimal places).

## Basis Q&A

**The holder quotes the reference "AHL-rem-0042". May it be recorded as "AHLREM0042"?** No. The reference is recorded exactly as the holder quotes it, character for character, keeping hyphens and case.

**May the same reference be recorded twice on one cover?** No. A reference is recorded once per cover.
